meta.project: Website Company Profile PT. Pesona Adi Batara (PAB)

product_overview: A company profile website that presents PT. Pesona Adi Batara's corporate information, services, news, career opportunities and contact channels, with an authenticated admin panel for content management.
core_goals: Allow public visitors to discover company overview, services, team and partners via a responsive homepage and dedicated pages.
Provide a browsable archive of company news and articles.
Enable visitors to view career information and submit inquiries via a contact form (including a dynamic WhatsApp contact).
Allow administrators to authenticate and access an admin dashboard to manage site content.

features.name: Public Website Browsing
features.description: Browse the public pages to read company information, recent news, career listings and contact details.
user_flows: Navigate to /news -> See list of news items with categories and publication dates
Navigate to /career -> See career listings and job information
Navigate to /contact -> See contact information and dynamic WhatsApp number
Navigate to /about -> See company history, vision, mission and team profiles

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Send a message to the company or view stored contact details (phone, email, address, dynamic WhatsApp) from the Contact page.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name field -> Fill in email field -> Fill in message field -> Submit contact form -> See confirmation message
Navigate to /contact -> Leave required field blank -> Submit contact form -> See validation error about missing field

features.name: News Listing
features.description: Browse the news and article archive to stay informed about company updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /news -> See list of news items with categories and publication dates

features.name: Administrator Login
features.description: Authenticate as an administrator to access the admin panel and manage site content.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> See /panel-pab/dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field with invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Admin Dashboard (Content Management)
features.description: Access the admin dashboard to view site analytics summary and open content editors to update public content.
user_flows: Navigate to /panel-pab/dashboard -> See dashboard summary and analytics
See list of content areas available to edit
Choose a content editor from dashboard -> Make changes to content -> Save changes -> Navigate to / -> See updated content on public site

features.name: User Login
user_interactions: See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Public Pages
user_interactions: Navigate through home, about, and contact pages
